# Consistency check: `feat/preguntas-en-la-card` against `d09d518`

Repository: `/home/agus/.herdr/worktrees/agentic-engineering-famaf-extension-course/feat-preguntas-en-la-card` (kurasu in `app/`). Paths below are relative to that root.

Read: `app/docs/README.md`, every note in `app/docs/architecture/` the change touches, `app/docs/prototipos/README.md` and the prototypes, `app/AGENTS.md`, `.mahou/wiki/` (`INDEX.md`, `web.md`, `fence.md`, `architecture.md`, `api.md`, `alchemy/local-tests.md`), and the code in `packages/core`, `packages/database`, `packages/contract`, `apps/api/src`, `apps/web/src` and the test helpers and fixtures the change touched.

## Leftovers

1. **`app/apps/web/src/features/sessions/rail-look.ts:5`**: `export type RailLook = Exclude<RailNodeLook, "locked" | "new">` is exported, but nothing outside the file imports it (`grep RailLook` finds only `rail-look.ts:5` and `:10`). `RailNodeLook` in `RailNode.tsx` is the type that lists the looks, and `SessionRailNode` takes `Exclude<RailNodeLook, "new">`. Fix: drop the `export`, or inline the return type of `railLook`.

2. **`app/packages/database/src/database.ts:9`**: `export interface Statement { toSQL: … }` is the same structural type as the core's `Write` (`packages/core/src/batch.ts:6`). Since the change, `repositoryOf` builds `Write`s and `D1Batch` passes `Write`s to `batch(client, …)`, which is still typed `ReadonlyArray<Statement>`; `repository.ts:41` and `:64` still import and use `Statement`. Two names exist for one shape. Fix: type `batch` and the repository's `Write<R>` with the core's `Write` and delete `Statement`.

## Docs vs code

1. **The featured switch fails silently when no other session is featured.** `app/apps/web/src/features/sessions/FeaturedSwitch.tsx:56-59` featuring a session when `featured == null` calls `update.mutate({ … featured: true })` with no dialog, and `useUpdateSession.ts:32-40` (`toastOf`) returns `undefined` for `{ featured: true }`, so a failed request shows nothing. Docs: `carga-y-acciones-de-la-web.md:85` says "Destacar una sesión … queda[n] en espera, porque pasan por un diálogo … si fallan, el error aparece dentro del diálogo", and `invariantes.md` says "Una acción en espera muestra su error dentro de su formulario o modal". The code has no dialog in this case and no toast either. Fix: give `{ featured: true }` a toast in `toastOf` (the "toast cuando no tiene ninguno de los dos" path of `carga-y-acciones-de-la-web.md`), and change line 85 to say the dialog appears only when another session is featured. The alternative is to always confirm featuring.

2. **Disabling the featured session shows its error twice.** `EnabledSwitch.tsx:47-58` runs `update.mutateAsync({ change: { enabled: false } })` inside `ConfirmAction`, so the dialog shows `updateErrorText`. `toastOf` (`useUpdateSession.ts:38-40`) also returns "No se pudo deshabilitar la sesión." for any `enabled: false` without `featured`, and it does not check whether the session is the featured one, so a toast appears as well. `carga-y-acciones-de-la-web.md:85` and `estados-de-encuestas-y-sesiones.md` ("si fallan, el error aparece dentro del diálogo, que sigue abierto") describe only the in-dialog error. Fix: let the caller turn off the toast for the confirmed path, for example by passing the session's `featured` in `SessionUpdate`, or by moving the toast to the instant caller's `onError`.

3. **`app/docs/architecture/acceso-a-datos.md:76-77`** ("Por qué una sentencia de batch no devuelve filas") says "una sentencia de batch no devuelve nada". In code, `repository.ts:227-229` builds `writes.update` and `writes.updateWhere` with `.returning({ id: table.id })`, and `removing` (`repository.ts:206-211`, used by `writes.remove` and `writes.removeWhere`) uses `.returning()` with every column. These writes now go into `Batch.run` in `Sessions.updateLeaving` (`hands.writes.removeWhere`, `store.writes.update`, `polls.writes.updateWhere`), in addition to the existing material batches. The batch drops the rows (`database.ts:52`, `Effect.asVoid`), so what is true is that *the batch* returns nothing, not that the statement does. This predates the change, but the change makes the core depend on it. Fix: reword the callout to say that `Batch.run` (and `repository.batch`) returns nothing and discards what the statements return.

4. **`app/docs/architecture/modelo-de-datos.md:139`** says "[La mano] Existe hasta que alguien baja la mano, el estudiante o el profe". `Sessions.updateLeaving` (`packages/core/src/sessions/sessions.ts:139`) also removes every hand of a session that stops being featured, as `estados-de-encuestas-y-sesiones.md` and `acceso-a-datos.md` say. Fix: add "o hasta que la sesión deja de ser la destacada (ver [estados de encuestas y sesiones](estados-de-encuestas-y-sesiones.md))". `tiempo-real-del-aula.md:68` ("La mano sigue levantada si el estudiante sale y vuelve, hasta que alguien la baja.") needs the same clause.

5. **Prototypes that still number the sessions.** `app/docs/prototipos/piezas.html:219` draws each rail node with `${i + 1}` and the `live` look for every enabled session. `app/docs/prototipos/marca-cuervo.html:201,211,218` draws a numbered node and the kicker "Sesión 2 de ${SESSIONS.length}". The code draws no number and no "Sesión N de M" (`SessionRailNode.tsx`, `AdminFeatured.tsx`, `FeaturedSession.tsx`), and `estados-de-encuestas-y-sesiones.md` states "Ningún círculo lleva número". These prototypes are linked from `carga-y-acciones-de-la-web.md` and `componentes.md` for other subjects (the shared pieces, the brand), so the session list in them is background. Fix: draw the nodes with the check, star or empty looks and drop the kicker, or add a line to `prototipos/README.md` saying that their session list is not the current one.

## Code vs code

1. **`app/apps/web/test/helpers/session-store.ts:50-58`** mimics the API when a session is featured or disabled: it sets `featured: false` on the session that leaves. It leaves `featuredQuestions` as it was. The API (`Sessions.updateLeaving`, `sessions.ts:134`) writes `{ featured: false, featuredQuestions: false }` to the leaving session. A test that disables, unmarks or replaces a featured session with featured questions on then sees `featuredQuestions: true` on a session that is not featured, a state the API never returns (`modelo-de-datos.md`: "solo la destacada tiene `featured_questions` en verdadero"). Fix: set `featuredQuestions: false` wherever the helper sets `featured: false`.

## Vocabulary

1. **`app/packages/database/src/repository.ts:225` and `:275`**: the comment "A statement reads nothing after its write, so several can go in one D1 batch." sits above `const writes`, and `batch: (statements: ReadonlyArray<Statement>) => …` keeps the old name for its parameter, although the change renamed `statements` to `writes`. Fix: "A write reads nothing after itself…" and `batch: (writes: ReadonlyArray<Write>) => …` (see Leftovers 2).

2. **`app/packages/core/src/hands/hands.ts:15-17`**: "A student raises and lowers their own in an enabled session". `raise` and `lowerOwn` now require `featuredSession` (`hands.ts:62,74`). Fix: "in the featured session".

3. **`app/packages/core/src/questions/questions.ts:82`**: "An open question of an enabled session: what the student can act on." `findOpenQuestion` now checks `featuredSession` (`:91`). Fix: "of the featured session". The service comment at `:35-38` ("The student sees the open questions of enabled sessions … votes at most once each … and deletes only their own") puts reading and writing in one sentence. Reading is still any enabled session, but asking, voting and deleting are now limited to the featured one. Fix: add "and asks, votes and deletes only in the featured session".

4. **`.mahou/wiki/web.md:17`**: "wrap a whole card (the highlighted session, each card of a folding section, …)". The code calls this card the featured session (`FeaturedSession`, `AdminFeatured`), and `HighlightedSession` no longer exists. Fix: "the featured session". The line is not false about skeletons, so the entry needs no other change.

5. **`app/apps/web/test/loading.test.tsx:67-79`**: the variables `highlighted`, `earlier` and `earlierCards` name the featured card and the "Todas las sesiones" section, which the change renamed from the highlighted session and `EarlierSessions`. Fix: `featuredCard`, `allSessions`, `allCards`.

6. **`app/docs/prototipos/inicio-responsive.html:100,297-309,336,452,472,478,508,594,616,712`**: the prototype's state key and helper are `highlighted` / `highlightedIn`, and its comments say "highlighted card" and "highlighted session". `:508` says "Only the highlighted session takes new questions and votes; earlier ones are read-only", but every non-featured session is read-only, including the ones after it (`estados-de-encuestas-y-sesiones.md`: "Cualquier otra sesión de la lista … en ella no se pregunta ni se vota"; `SessionLinks` passes `readOnly={!featured}`). Fix: rename to `featured` / `featuredIn`, and change `:508` to "every other session is read-only".

## Not reported

- `app/apps/web/src/routes/_app/index.tsx:46-47`: the empty-state text "Cuando el profe habilite la primera, aparece acá arriba." could look like a leftover of the "last enabled" rule. The prototype (`inicio-responsive.html:487`) keeps the same text, and the enable modal features the session by default, so this follows a recorded design.
- `app/apps/web/test/fixtures/content.ts:22` `lastFeatured(...)`: it marks the last session of a fixture list as featured, explicitly. It builds data for the new rule and does not rely on the old derived one.
- `app/apps/api/test/unfeatured.test.ts:21,41`: the test names mention "the last enabled one" to check that the old rule no longer applies.
- `app/packages/core/src/announcements/announcements.ts:49`: `const visibleSessions = yield* Sessions` is used only for `featured()`. The name comes from commit `1b2a4e3`, before `d09d518`, and does not describe a student write.
- `app/docs/prototipos/aula-responsive.html:196`: "Sesión 2 de 6" is the text of an example slide, not app UI.
- Remaining `visibleSession` calls (`hands.ts:51`, `questions.ts:100`, `polls.ts:171`, `materials.ts:69`, `sessions.ts:164`) are student reads, which `invariantes.md` allows on any enabled session.
- `.mahou/wiki/architecture.md`, `api.md`, `fence.md`, `alchemy/local-tests.md` and `app/AGENTS.md`: no line is made false by the change. They do not mention `NotFeatured`, `SwitchButton`, `count-label`, `findFeatured`, `switch-row`, `blush`/`wine` or the third type parameter of `useApiQuery`. That information is missing, but nothing there contradicts the code.
